name: NETSTREIT
outlook:
What NETSTREIT says to expect

  • Full year 2026: AFFO per share and cash G&AThe Company is maintaining both its full year 2026 AFFO per share guidance range of $1.37 to $1.39 and its cash G&A range of $16.5 million to $17.0 million (exclusive of transaction costs and severance payments). The Company now expects 2026 net investment activity of at least $800 million vs. its prior range of $700 million to $800 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
